name: Cataclysmic Prospecting
oracle_text: Cataclysmic Prospecting deals X damage to each creature. For each mana from a Desert spent to cast this spell, create a tapped Treasure token.
blocked_sentences: For each mana from a Desert spent to cast this spell, create a tapped Treasure token.

needs.what: a value that counts how many units of mana spent to cast this spell came from permanents matching a selector (here subtypes ["Desert"]), read off the cast object, e.g. {"mana_spent_from": {"subtypes": ["Desert"]}}, so the Treasure create_token (treasure_token, tapped: true) can take it as its amount
needs.why_existing_wont_do: mana_spent_of is the total mana spent with no source filter, colors_of_mana_spent counts colours, and the paid_by selector/trigger filter only answers whether any mana from a matching source was spent (a boolean over the deduplicated mana_spent_traits set of ManaOrigin), not how many pips came from it
